Asset type: transparent torn-paper collage word for Dennis Agerblad's existing website menu.
Edit target: Image 1, the existing Danish MUSiK graphic. Supporting insert/reference: Image 2, existing PERFORMANCE graphic; reuse its blue C on yellow paper.
Primary request: Localize the word to MUSIC (M U S i C). Preserve the exact existing M, U, S and lowercase i letter shapes, ink colors and torn paper textures from image 1. Replace only K with the C letter and its yellow torn paper from image 2. Every letter must look like a real irregularly torn magazine/paper clipping, with all outer paper edges intact and natural texture; no mechanically rectangular cropped blocks.
Accents: Replace existing accents with exactly two short white rays immediately outside the left end of the word and two short yellow rays immediately outside the right end. Rays radiate away from the center of the word, fanning outward toward upper-left/lower-left and upper-right/lower-right, respectively. All four marks have the same physical length and thickness: length about 25% of the median ink letter height, thickness about 6%. They must look hand-painted, solid and simple, with no extra tiny rays. Clear small gap from paper, no overlapping letters, no floating distant ray cluster.
Composition: One horizontal MUSIC word only, tightly framed with a small transparent margin sufficient for all rays and torn edges. Keep individual letter height approximately equal and the slight irregular tilts of the original collage. Keep the same colors and identity; this is an edit, not a redesign.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, no opaque backdrop, no shadow baked onto a rectangle.
Text (verbatim): MUSIC.
Avoid: added words, borders, 3D effects, new font styling, white card rectangles, cut-off paper edges, incorrect spelling.
